summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised via 7 backend pytest files + 7 browser checks. 14/14 artifacts passed.
action_items: Minor note (not a bug per matrix wording): /api/dashboard 'asamalar' stage breakdown still returns non-zero 'tutar' for the izleyici (view-only) role even though toplam_satis/net_kar are correctly zeroed. The explicit criterion (toplam_satis/net_kar = 0) passes, but the per-stage tutar array is a residual financial leak worth a follow-up look if SEC-002 is meant to mask ALL financial figures, not just the top-line totals.
